'''Yawnelly''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Lullelly|Lullely]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Souverelle]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Yawnelly's 'How to Nap' tutorial was just falling asleep mid-explanation. [[Sparkdoe]] took notes but learned nothing."

Yawnelly is a gold rarity Tatari.

== Appearance ==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Yawnelly's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Souverelle]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Yawnelly to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x2000) or [[Marathon Party]] (use skateboard x2000).
